# Process-wide log

The log every thread shares, written to standard error.

<h2 id="set-level"><code>SetLevel</code></h2>

```rux
pub func SetLevel(level: Level)
```

Writes process-wide records at `level` and above from now on. The level starts as `Info`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Global.rux#L20)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type    | Description                    |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------ |
| `level` | `Level` | the least severe level written |

<h2 id="set-format"><code>SetFormat</code></h2>

```rux
pub func SetFormat(format: LogFormat)
```

Writes process-wide records in `format` from now on. The format starts as [`Text`](/docs/api/log/field#text).

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Global.rux#L27)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type        | Description             |
| -------- | ----------- | ----------------------- |
| `format` | `LogFormat` | how records are written |

<h2 id="set-timestamps"><code>SetTimestamps</code></h2>

```rux
pub func SetTimestamps(enabled: bool)
```

Whether process-wide records start with the time. They start with it.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Global.rux#L34)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type   | Description               |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------- |
| `enabled` | `bool` | whether to write the time |

<h2 id="enabled"><code>Enabled</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Enabled(level: Level) -> bool
```

Whether a process-wide record at `level` would be written.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Global.rux#L42)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type    | Description            |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------- |
| `level` | `Level` | the level to ask about |

**Returns**: whether it would be written

<h2 id="log"><code>Log</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Log(
    level: Level,
    message: char8[..],
    fields: Field[..]
)
```

Writes a process-wide record at `level` with `message` and `fields` to standard error, if the level is enabled.
A record that cannot be written is dropped.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Global.rux#L53)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type        | Description                |
| --------- | ----------- | -------------------------- |
| `level`   | `Level`     | how severe it is           |
| `message` | `char8[..]` | what happened              |
| `fields`  | `Field[..]` | the values that go with it |
